name: mnote_create_page
description: Create a page in a notebook (`notebook` slug). `title` is the page title; `body` is the note content as plain MARKDOWN (headings, lists, code fences, tables, task lists) — write clean, well-structured markdown. `parent` optionally nests this page under another page in the same notebook (that page's slug). The slug is derived from the title (auto-deduped). Requires the notes:write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the created page including its new slug.

notebook.description: Notebook slug to create the page in.

parent.description: Optional parent page slug (nest under it), same notebook.
